issue.title: Add multi-signer threshold verification to escrow contract
issue.body:
## Description
Implement multi-signer threshold verification for batch payouts in the Soroban escrow smart contract so releases require quorum approval before transferring tokens.

## Requirements and context
- Store signer addresses and threshold weights in persistent contract storage.
- Enforce caller authorization on every state transition with `require_auth`.
- Reject duplicate signer entries and zero-threshold configurations.

## Done when
- [ ] Multi-signer storage and quorum verification implemented in `contracts/escrow/src/lib.rs`
- [ ] Unit and integration tests covering threshold edge cases pass via `cargo test`
- [ ] Contract compiles cleanly with `stellar contract build` and passes Wasm size check

## Files to touch
- `contracts/escrow/src/lib.rs`
- `contracts/escrow/src/test.rs`

## Suggested execution
1. Define the signer configuration types and contract storage keys.
2. Implement `require_auth` verification across the configured signer set.
3. Add unit tests in `contracts/escrow/src/test.rs` for valid quorum, duplicate signers, and unauthorized callers.
4. Run `cargo test` and `stellar contract build` to verify contract behavior and Wasm size.

Complexity: High
